verdict.rationale: Warp explicitly advertises running many agents concurrently across repos or tasks (parallelism), plus schedules for recurring tasks and triggers reacting to events across many items via Oz CLI/cloud agents, which directly supports bulk automation-depth. However, this is documented only in vendor docs with no independent hands-on evidence of scale, limits, or reliability at bulk volume. missing for 10: independent verification of parallel/bulk operation limits, concrete examples of bulk tasks executed across many items, hands-on community reports validating this at scale.
